sources.name: Maternal-Newborn Nursing: Care in the Third Trimester of Pregnancy
sources.text: Ultrasound scans are performed to monitor fetal weight when the fundal height is more than 2 cm below or above the expected measurement. Additional laboratory testing is performed at 36 weeks of gestation.
